component.name: word-sys's PDF Editor
component.summary: Edit text content in PDF files

description.p: An open-source tool for editing content in PDF files on Linux. Edit text and images directly on the page, merge and reorder pages, draw shapes and highlights, and export to PDF or plain text.

screenshot.caption: Main window of word-sys PDF Editor
Editing text and annotations in a PDF file

description.p: GTK file dialog version compatibility fix, export format resolution fix, and Pango markup escaping for recent files.
Adds hyperlink annotation support with link de-duplication, plus localization and bold-underline fixes.
